rules: Select a quantitatively complete cohort comparison with explicit all-cause death counts for both source-defined exposure groups.
Exposure may be LGE or a source-defined myocardial-fibrosis representation; retain its reported definition.
Do not select a composite endpoint merely because it includes death, transplantation, heart-failure hospitalization, ICD therapy, or arrhythmia.
Do not use target-review values, annualized event rates, or article-specific curator labels.

method_selection_policy: After identifying eligible independent evidence, select and justify a synthesis approach from the study data. The participant package does not prescribe a computation method.
